dedupe_keys.name: location of grain silos in south africa with capacities and distances to markets

description: This dataset locates grain silos in South Africa, with storage capacities for different types of grain and shipping distances to the main commodity markets. The DataCite record from SAEON says it was digitised from records kept by the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to inform commodity prices and availability, and that the data are in the public domain. It was compiled by Leo Chiloane, is valid for 2014 and was registered on 7 March 2018 on the SAEON open data platform, free under CC BY-SA 4.0, with national coverage. Caveats: the silo list reflects 2014, the number of silos and the file format are not stated on the page read, and later closures or new storage are not covered. For simulation it gives the grain storage network with capacities, a key node layer in food supply chain models, for testing how floods, power cuts or rail and road disruption at silos affect grain availability and prices. Related catalogue records include the updated South African cropland 2013-2015 and the Global supply chain logistics excavator data.
